headline: JioBlackRock Flexicap shifts portfolio with new additions and exits in September
summary: JioBlackRock Flexicap underwent a major portfolio reshuffle in September, adding 19 new stocks including Redington, Apollo Hospitals, and GAIL. Despite these tactical portfolio changes, the fund's year-to-date decline stands at 6.67%, closely tracking the 6.96% fall in its benchmark Nifty 500 TRI. Retail investors tracking mutual fund activity can note these stock preferences as an indicator of the fund manager's sector rotation.

headline: Hospital stocks rise despite government capping trade margins on non-scheduled cancer drugs at 30%
hook: Trade margin cap hits cancer drug prices
summary: The Indian government has capped trade margins on non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs at 30 percent, aiming to cut retail prices by 20 to 70 percent and save patients ₹2,500 crore annually. Shares of hospital operators like Fortis Healthcare, Apollo Hospitals, Max Healthcare, and Medanta rallied following the announcement. Brokerages noted that while earnings impacts may be manageable, hospital margins could face near-term pressure from reduced drug sales revenue. Indian retail investors tracking healthcare stocks should monitor how individual hospital chains adjust their pharmacy revenue models.

why_it_matters: Hospital pharmacy margins face pressure from drug price caps
winners_losers: Patients gain / hospital pharmacy margins hurt
